items.quote: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,
items.claim: Abraham got up from beside his dead and spoke to the sons of Heth.
items.mechanism: a direct spoken appeal to the local group

items.quote: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you:
items.claim: Abraham called himself a stranger and a sojourner among the sons of Heth, meaning a resident outsider with no land of his own there.
items.action: described himself as a stranger and sojourner
items.object: his own status among the sons of Heth
items.mechanism: stating his outsider status as the reason for his request

items.quote: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
items.claim: Abraham asked the sons of Heth to give him a burial place as a possession so he could bury his dead.
items.action: asked for a burial place as a possession
items.mechanism: asking to get land held as a possession so he could bury his dead
